images.name: 01_map_of_the_arena
images.final_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create image 01_map_of_the_arena, a landscape 16:9 illustrated map. Reference 1 style_map.png is STYLE ONLY: match its top-down hand-drawn children's-book map, stained cream paper, ink and crayon scribbles, coloured-pencil shading, white rounded labels. DO NOT copy its attractions or rectangular layout. Reference 2 ref_plan.png is layout only; do not copy its legend or text.
The hall is ROUND, a thick dark circular wall filling the page height with enough margins for the north slide and south entrance. North is up. Everything inside the wall except the small central court and narrow paths is dense soft-play frame: yellow, red, blue and green padded posts, black netting, coloured mat decks, crawl tubes, slides. SIX concentric rings round the centre like a target or stadium from above, each ring outward a step higher: 2,4,6,8,10,12 storeys. No bare floor surrounding it; frame meets wall everywhere.
Exact centre: small round court, blue-green checker foam floor, yellow ring, short red post and child's crayon stick figure with "1 2 3" beside it. White rounded label "THE POST". At bottom south a small tunnel pokes through wall, red arrow pointing inward, white rounded label "YOU ARRIVE HERE". Little blue gate sign at tunnel-wall meeting reads "PLAY ZONE". One straight pale-green path from gate north to court. Eight foam stair aisles radiate like spokes, separate from entrance lane, positions matching plan. Few solid-colour tube slides descend rings: orange into court, blue northwest, green southeast, yellow southwest. At very top north a big RED spiral slide goes OUT through wall.
One big white rounded label across rings "THE BIG FRAME". Small numbers on successive rings from centre out "2", "4", "6", "8", "10", "12". EXACTLY these four word labels, spelled correctly: THE BIG FRAME, THE POST, PLAY ZONE, YOU ARRIVE HERE. Only other text is required numbers and crayon 1 2 3. No title, legend or extra lettering.
No reception, snack bar, party rooms, inflatables, ball pit, arcade or other attraction. No actual people, animals, watermark, HUD or UI. Only requested crayon stick figure. Keep whole circular arena and all labels inside landscape image.
RETRY correction: precisely six numeric badges in the left radial row, reading LEFT TO RIGHT from wall toward centre: 12, 10, 8, 6, 4, 2. The third ring from centre MUST have 6, never a duplicate 4. Ensure top red spiral slide and its exit beyond wall fit fully inside image with a small paper margin, and bottom label also fits. All tubes/slides one solid colour each. Preserve reference style and exact four word labels.
images.weakness: North red spiral is clipped at the top; terrace heights are schematic rather than measurable.

images.name: 04_the_whole_arena_from_above
images.final_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Photoreal architectural horror concept art, 16:9 landscape image 04_the_whole_arena_from_above.
References in order: 1 liked_from_above for photographic materials, abandoned soft-play mood and light ONLY, NOT its old layout or extra attractions; 2 ref_plan for exact round plan; 3 ref_section for the upper NEW DRAFT: THE BOWL section ONLY, NOT the well alternative; 4 liked_court for worn padded posts, black nets, foam checker floor, red post and yellow ring materials.
High three-quarter aerial view of the WHOLE ROUND hall with roof cut away, from above SOUTH looking NORTH, wide lens with entire perimeter comfortably inside image. A 155 metre diameter round concrete warehouse hall with nominal roof 42 metres up. The entire hall is a colosseum made entirely of soft-play frame. Six concentric annular terraces encircle a small bright round court 22 metres across, 360 degrees. Each ring is exactly TWO storeys taller than the inner one: 2 storeys at court, then 4,6,8,10,12 against concrete wall, a storey 2.8 metres. Six broad terraces each 11 metres deep rise UP AND OUT from low centre like stadium seating. Show two netted deck levels on each terrace riser; all under-terrace volume filled with dense padded frame, mat decks, net corridors, crawl tubes. Outer terrace meets hall wall everywhere, zero surrounding bare hall floor. NOT a central mountain and NOT a vertical well. Eight foam stair aisles run radially up terraces like stadium spokes.
Small centre court blue-and-green checker foam puzzle mats with yellow ring and short red padded post beneath brightest light. No entity or people. Foreground bottom south: small low tunnel through wall, gateway with padded blue lintel WITHOUT lettering, and one straight narrow checker-floor entrance lane between net fences through all six rings to court. The lane forms a deep canyon, 12 storeys at gateway tapering to 2 at court.
Solid-colour glossy plastic tube slides lie down terraces: orange into court, blue northwest, green southeast, yellow southwest; giant RED spiral slide stands on topmost ring on far NORTH side and exits through wall. Every tube slide ONE solid bright colour, never striped.
Photoreal as liked references: dim, dusty, abandoned, quiet, sparse cold-white fluorescent pools of light, dead fixtures, haze, long shadows, slightly brighter and saturated so padding colours read. Steel posts wrapped in worn yellow red blue green vinyl, black knotted safety-net fences, padded rails, coloured vinyl decks, occasional square red panels with round clear bubble windows. A few loose balls on court only. Roof cut away for full arena visibility, only peripheral exposed steel truss/duct remnants allowed, do not occlude bowl.
No text of any kind, no lettering even on gate, no watermark HUD UI. No people children animals or doll. No reception snack bar party rooms inflatables ball pit arcade neon or any other attraction. No bare hall floor around structure. Entire hall footprint filled by concentric frame except tiny central court, narrow entrance lane and stair aisles. Preserve visibly six steps rising away from court all the way around.
images.weakness: Perimeter and north slide are cropped; exact 2–12-storey heights and eight aisles are not reliably resolved, and green slide is northeast. Retry added an unwanted bare perimeter, so first generation retained.
